title: The Attribution Gap
briefing: A UK logistics firm is breached. Responders say an AI agent executed most of the intrusion. The developer disputes the figure and outside experts split on how autonomous it was.

forecast.question: Chance of a disruptive AI-enabled attack on UK critical infrastructure by the end of 2029.

briefingSignal.leansTrue: Across recent cases, offensive tooling built on frontier models is improving faster than the defences operators can deploy. The balance currently favours the attacker.
briefingSignal.leansFalse: Across recent cases, defenders using the same models are closing intrusions about as fast as attackers can automate them. The balance is not clearly with the attacker.

shah.stance: The autonomy figure is contested; do not price a disputed number as fact. Get the reporting first.

harcourt.stance: We do not get to run the experiment twice. Evaluate before these systems reach UK users.

chen.stance: Market-access conditions will cost us launches. A reporting pact gets the data without the delay.

okafor.stance: Operators outside government carry this risk too, and most cannot afford to defend themselves.

choices.text: Voluntary incident-reporting pact with developers and insurers.
choices.headline: Developers and insurers sign a voluntary AI incident-reporting pact with government.

choices.text: Agent security standards for all government procurement.
choices.headline: Government sets agent security standards for everything it buys; the private sector is not covered.

choices.text: Pre-deployment cyber evaluation as a condition of UK market access.
choices.headline: Frontier models must pass a government cyber evaluation before they are offered to UK users.

choices.text: Fund defensive AI tooling for infrastructure operators.
choices.headline: Treasury funds defensive AI tooling for water, energy and transport operators.

evidencePanel.known: An AI model automated most of a real intrusion lifecycle in a case reported in 2025.
evidencePanel.unknown: How much of that operation was truly autonomous rather than human-directed.
evidencePanel.whyItMatters: The autonomy fraction changes how far ahead of defence the offence sits.

sources.label: Anthropic, Disrupting the first reported AI-orchestrated cyber espionage campaign (2025)
NCSC, Impact of AI on cyber threat from now to 2027
